repos.object: Epistemic disagreement and rationale-probing module (`L6`) for the Auto-Lab brain: rather than collapsing scientific uncertainty into a binary verdict, it retrieves verbatim evidence sentences on each side of a claim, surfaces necessary assumptions, and frames the discriminating experimental result that would resolve the disagreement.
repos.data: Evaluates on the SciFact dev split (Wadden et al., EMNLP 2020; CC BY-NC 2.0, fetched on demand to gitignored `data/` with zero redistribution: 5,183 corpus abstracts, 300 dev claims, and 209 evidence-bearing `(claim, doc_id)` pairs across 138 `SUPPORT` and 71 `CONTRADICT`) and integrates a 14-dataset `OpenDatasetSpec` registry (`src/lab_ask_why/datasets.py`, 11 from 2024-2026: `LABBench2` 2026, `PeerQA-XT` 2026, `SciVer` 2025, `CLAIMCHECK` 2025, `ChemBench` 2025, `LitQA2` 2024, `LAB-Bench ProtocolQA` 2024, `ConflictBank` 2024, `FaithEval-inconsistent` 2024, `SciRIFF` 2024, `BioASQ` 2024, plus `SciFact-Open`, `SciFact`, and `PubMedQA`) with `eval_only` canary/training blocks and `NormalizedClaimRecord` adapters.

Achieves 0.493 Hit@1 (`recall@1`) and 0.789 Hit@3 (`recall@3`) on 209 SciFact dev claim-abstract pairs vs. 0.197 +- 0.024 and 0.528 +- 0.029 for 20-seed random ranking, with near-symmetric performance on `SUPPORT` (0.507 / 0.797) and `CONTRADICT` (0.465 / 0.775).

repos.tagline: Uncertainty-aware experiment advisor combining split conformal prediction intervals, kNN trust-region abstention, and active boundary expansion

Dual lower-bound optimality certification (best_bound and gap_pct) distinguishing proven global optima (15/30 instances at 0.0% gap) from time-bounded feasible solutions.

repos.tagline: Teacher-to-student logit distillation and byte-packed int8/4-bit post-training quantization baseline for low-power benchtop inference.
repos.object: Forms the L0 compute substrate of Auto-Lab so the lab agent can run autonomously on inexpensive edge boards mounted beside instruments: cloud GPUs train large teacher models in short bursts, while compact student networks are distilled, quantized to int8 and packed 4-bit weights, and executed locally with deterministic batch-1 latency.
repos.data: Evaluates teacher-to-student distillation and byte-packed `int8` / `4-bit` quantization on scikit-learn's bundled 8x8 digits dataset (1,797 images, 70/30 split at `SEED=0`) and integrates a 7-dataset `OpenEdgeDataset` registry (`src/lab_feet/datasets.py`: `MNIST-1D`, `UCI Gas Sensor Array Drift` 10 chronological 36-month aging batches, `UCI HAR Inertial`, `CWRU Bearing Vibration`, `UCI Hydraulic Vibration`, `SERS Bacteria Raman 2026` 1,215 channels, and `Ethanol NIR Spectroscopy` 1,751 through-glass channels) with `SAFE_HOLD` temporal-drift abstaining `int4` evaluation and SPDX license verification.
repos.model: ReLU MLPClassifier teacher with hidden layers (256, 256) (85,002 params, 340,008 B fp32) paired with 32-unit single-hidden-layer ReLU students (2,410 params, 9,640 B fp32; 35.3x fewer parameters) compressed via symmetric per-tensor post-training weight quantization to int8 (2,544 B) and packed two-nibbles-per-byte signed 4-bit (1,360 B; 250.0x smaller than teacher), evaluated through one shared numpy forward pass.
repos.training: Compares hard-label cross-entropy student training (MLPClassifier, max_iter=300) against high-temperature scaled logit regression (MLPRegressor fit to teacher pre-softmax logits / T at T=4.0, max_iter=500, avoiding premature tol stopping on flat softmax targets). Honestly documents both that hard-label training slightly beats pure uncentered logit MSE on this clean toy task (0.9741 vs 0.9685) and that quantized models run dequantized fp32 matmuls in numpy (saving 3.8x-7.1x memory with 100% int8 / 98.89% 4-bit prediction agreement, while wall-clock integer speedups await C++/NPU runtimes).
repos.history: Initial baseline `a7b1532` on `main` (2026-11-18: teacher-student distillation, symmetric `int8` & nibble-packed `4-bit` quantizer, docs `6a600de`), followed by Phase-2 Lean/wire & `LFT1` runtime merge (`8b0338a`, PR #32) and the 7-dataset 2024-2026 edge sensor, gas-drift, vibration & Raman/NIR registry on `main` (`98a995b`, PR #33).
unique_properties: True two's-complement nibble packing and unpacking (pack_4bit / unpack_4bit, two signed -8..7 weights per uint8 byte) verified in-loop during accuracy evaluation rather than simulated via float clamping alone.
Framework-neutral batch-1 latency harness (200 warmup + 2,000 single-sample passes) using a single raw numpy forward() kernel across classifier, regressor, and quantized variants.

250x end-to-end model footprint reduction from fp32 teacher (340,008 bytes) to 4-bit distilled student (1,360 bytes, including fp32 biases and per-tensor fp32 scales) within 1.3 percentage points of teacher accuracy.
